# The ratchet: packages that are permitted to import non-keep deprecated
# packages, one `<importer> -> <imported>  # reason` per line.
#
# Living packages must not depend on packages pkg/pkgselect/DEPRECATED drops
# without a keep line. A keep line there permits importing that package;
# it is never permission for that package's test dependencies to import non-keep
# retired packages. Every lift out of nsprint eliminates one or more edges.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestLivingPackagesDoNotImportDroppedDeprecatedPackages
# checks it in both directions: an unlisted edge is a red run, and a listed edge
# whose import has been removed is also a red run.
#
# ceiling: 0
